prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Raju bhai, Vicky, Raju K, Sunita didi.
The chat covers 04/03/26, 8:30 pm to 04/03/26, 10:30 pm. It must have exactly 23 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
04/03/26, 9:14 pm - Raju bhai: Vicky, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.

nonce: 1
text:
04/03/26, 8:30 pm - Sunita didi: Aaj ki shop ki closing entries complete ho gayi kya?
04/03/26, 8:34 pm - Vicky: Haan didi, main register maintain kar raha hoon.
04/03/26, 8:38 pm - Raju K: Sunita didi, ek stranger ka phone aaya tha QR code scanner ke regarding.
04/03/26, 8:42 pm - Raju bhai: Kisi ko phone pe OTP ya PIN mat dena, koi bhi ho.
04/03/26, 8:47 pm - Sunita didi: Sahi bola Raju bhai, kal mere paas bhi fake customer payment message aaya tha.
04/03/26, 8:52 pm - Vicky: Maine 50,000 ka ek transfer receive kiya hai shop account me abhi.
04/03/26, 8:56 pm - Raju K: Kiska payment tha ye Vicky? Customer ne to bas 5,000 dene the.
04/03/26, 9:01 pm - Raju bhai: Vicky, wo payment mere dost ka tha, galti se yahan aa gaya.
04/03/26, 9:05 pm - Sunita didi: Lekin humare QR code pe direct payment kyu aaya?
04/03/26, 9:08 pm - Vicky: Raju bhai maine wo baki paise cash me unke banda ko de diye.
04/03/26, 9:11 pm - Raju K: Cash me kyu diye? Ye to doubtful lag raha hai.
04/03/26, 9:14 pm - Raju bhai: Vicky, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
04/03/26, 9:18 pm - Vicky: Ok bhai, app history se clear kar deta hoon.
04/03/26, 9:23 pm - Sunita didi: Ye galat hai Raju bhai, record delete kyu kar rahe ho?
04/03/26, 9:29 pm - Raju K: Bank se message aaya hai ki wo transaction flagged report me hai.
04/03/26, 9:34 pm - Raju bhai: Kuch nahi hoga, bas accounting confusion na ho isliye bol raha tha.
04/03/26, 9:40 pm - Vicky: Bhai delete nahi ho raha, permanent entry hai UPI dashboard pe.
04/03/26, 9:46 pm - Sunita didi: Kal subah bank branch jaake hi clear karenge.
04/03/26, 9:53 pm - Raju K: Haan cyber cell ki site pe check kiya, aisi fraud scheme chalti hai.
04/03/26, 10:01 pm - Raju bhai: Tum log faltu me tension mat lo, main sambhal lunga.
04/03/26, 10:09 pm - Vicky: Main toh ghabra gaya hoon, police complaint na ho jaye.
04/03/26, 10:17 pm - Sunita didi: Kisi ko darne ki zarurat nahi hai agar humne fraud nahi kiya.
04/03/26, 10:25 pm - Raju K: Sahi baat hai didi, kal morning me pehle manager se baat karenge.
